draw.convert.ink-to-text.note: U:slate/draw: hidden. Ink to Text needs a handwriting recogniser; the app has no handwriting engine (its OCR reads printed text from pictures, not pen strokes).

draw.convert.math.note: U:slate/draw: hidden. Ink to Math needs Microsoft's math handwriting recogniser; the app has no handwriting engine. Type equations in linear format on the Insert tab.

draw.convert.ink-editor.note: U:slate/draw: hidden. The Ink Editor is the correction pane of Ink to Text and Ink to Math, which are not offered.
